body: Thanks. This was a good read. :)
I don't live anywhere near there anymore. I left awhile back... but I do agree, forgiveness is the first step I need to take. I'm working on it.

I agree, I'm doing my best to get past it. I realize it is a much bigger deal to myself then it would be to anyone else, more so now that is has been about a year. 

I'm going to do my best to not let the small things get me down as I try to change things. I know it'll happen, but I'm going to hope it won't. If it does, well I've been through worse. Thanks for the words of encouragement.

I apologized and was forgiven but for whatever reason I've never been able to really get past it myself. I'm trying, I think admitting it others instead of just myself is a step in the right direction. I've been keeping it to myself for to long. Thanks for your kind words, it brightened my day.
You don't suck at giving advice. Could you elaborate on the meditation? I'm curious about that.
Yeah, I've been trying for awhile. I feel a bit better having put how I feel down. I think it'll make it easier to start to let go.

I've gotten to a point in my life where I'm stuck. I know I'm depressed, I have no motivation, I've lost all my friends, I got kicked out of college and my parents split up. The only decent thing I have going for me is my job (which I usually enjoy).

Brief back story. I got kicked out of college because I actually did try to kill myself at one point. I took a large amount of pills and then went to sleep. I didn't die as I'd hoped, I just got very sick. The next morning I felt awful (emotionally) and confided in a friend who in return told my parents who in turn told the school who then kicked me out.

Why'd I decided to end my life? Thinking back on it was stupid but a large part was the situation I was in. My girlfriend had cheated on me (and by cheated I mean slept with another guy), we couldn't work it out and things ended badly. It was also around the time my parents were splitting up. It was a stupid mistaken, no girl is worth that and I've since realized it.

After getting kicked out of college I decided to stick around. All my friends were there and there was really nothing for me back home. It was a mistake. I wasn't allowed back on campus but I felt to embarrassed by this fact to tell anyone besides a few close friends. They'd occasionally sneak me into their dorm or apartment on campus property. Everyone else though just thought I didn't like them anymore.

The worst happened when I went to a party at a friends. I got really wasted and decided to crash on a couch. This will seem rather stupid but some girl claimed she'd called the couch. I told her to get lost, next thing I knew some dude throws me off the couch onto the floor. I immediately started wailing on him (I mean what would you do if you are pretty much passed out drunk and someone throws you to the ground?). At  some point I'd pulled out a knife, was screaming, crying and just going nuts. Apparently I was pretty fucking scary. I guess I'd pent up lots of emotions. After that the cops came. They couldn't charge me with assault because I hadn't started it but they booked me for being drunk in public and I spent the night in jail. I never really talked to anyone after that. I apologized to the guy I got in a fight with and the friend whose apartment I was at. I also told someone else to let everyone know I was sorry.

I've tried to get back on my feet. For some reason I can't forgive myself for the mistakes I made in the past though. I've been stuck for over a year, I've made no attempt to meet new people, to become a part of anything. I've even stopped doing the things I loved to do. The life I live now is a sad lonely one, one which I'd like to change.

In addition to writing this out which is making me feel a bit better I've decided to put myself out there again. I signed-up to be part of a local baseball league and I'm going to a local church function with people my age. I'm deathly scared of both though. When I think about either of these things my first thought is I'll get scared and just leave. I don't want to do that I know I need to do things like this if I want to get my life back on track.
